clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Chef Grual keeps the Scarlet Raven Tavern's kitchen working. He feeds the Night Watch and weary travelers, though some ingredients raise eyebrows.

Darkshire's cook works with scarce supplies. Highwaymen, wolves, and undead harass the roads from Westfall and Stormwind, leaving fresh provisions hard to find. Grual makes do with what the wilderness offers. He cooks wolf flank and meat scavenged by local adventurers, using whatever reaches his kitchen.
